result.title: GaussianRenderFormer: Transformer-based Rendering of 3D Gaussian Splats
result.comment: Under review at TMLR. 32 pages. Project page: https://svlwoof.github.io/gaussianrenderformer
result.summary: Can a neural network learn to render 3D Gaussian splats on its own, with no rasterizer in the renderer? We present GaussianRenderFormer, a transformer that takes a set of Gaussians and a camera and outputs the image directly. Each Gaussian becomes one token in a view-independent encoder, and a view-dependent decoder turns small patches of camera rays into pixels by attending to those tokens. Trained on 26,820 Objaverse objects pruned to 20,000 Gaussians each, GaussianRenderFormer renders 300 unseen objects at 38.08 dB PSNR against the full, unpruned splats, while rasterizing the same pruned input reaches 44.02 dB. The gap is not one of generalization, and our diagnostics are consistent with a bottleneck in the view decoder: telling it the projected footprint of each Gaussian, which it could in principle infer, adds 1.4 dB. Under-training is not ruled out. Code, trained models and videos: https://svlwoof.github.io/gaussianrenderformer

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GaussianRenderFormer，用 Transformer 取代光栅化器做 3D Gaussian splatting 渲染：每个 Gaussian 作为视角无关编码器的一个 token，视角相关解码器让相机射线小块通过注意力读取这些 token 直接输出像素，并诊断出视角解码器存在瓶颈。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「信息本可推断却未被解码器利用」的诊断（显式给出 Gaussian 投影足迹仅增益 1.4 dB）可能与 LVR 中视觉细节留存于内部状态却未被答案真正使用的问题同构，可供核查；但任务本身是渲染，不含推理轨迹或停止决策。
